title: Persistent ship livery customization
description: Players pick a livery (3 paint colors) for their ship at the dock; it is persisted, rendered by all clients, and changeable at any dock.
acceptanceCriteria: Livery = {hull: '#rrggbb', accent: '#rrggbb', trim: '#rrggbb'}; ships.livery JSON column holds it (default per class from catalog)
POST /api/ships/livery {colors} (auth): validates hex format for all three slots, persists, returns the updated ship; if the player is in an active shard, broadcasts entity_update with the new livery

Client renderer applies livery colors to ship materials (3 paint zones) for local and remote ships; material swap does not cause a frame hitch above budget (spot-check with TASK-57 monitor when available)
API tests: valid update, invalid hex rejected 400, partial payload rejected, remote broadcast observed, restart persistence

steps.details: Extend ships route: zod schema with hex regex ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$ for the three named slots (strict object, no extra keys). Persist via repo.saveShipState (livery field).
Shard event bus: onLiveryChanged(playerId, livery) → entity_update to all in-system connections (EntityState.livery already exists in TASK-9 protocol).

ShipMeshBuilder: 3 materials mapped to paint zones (hull body, accent panels, trim lines); applyLivery(shipId, livery) swaps material colors in place (no mesh rebuild). Default livery per class in SHIP_CLASSES.
API + ws + persistence tests per acceptance list. Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: Colors are hex strings only — the renderer converts; no CSS color names in the protocol.
